title: andropogon gerardi subsp. chrysocomus
intro: Andropogon gerardi subsp. chrysocomus, commonly known as Buffalo Grass, is a type of perennial grass native to North America. It is valued for its drought tolerance and ability to grow in a wide range of environments. The health benefits of Buffalo Grass include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which may also exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
